why: The new surface rule forbidding cuts immediately after main verbs made the model avoid splitting verb+complement sequences, which improved cohesion for longer/complex spans (bins >7) but displaced cuts into adjacent very short pieces and enumerations, worsening many ≤5-token cases; net effect is near-zero but slightly negative.
lesson: A verb–complement prohibition helps longer/more complex pieces but harms very short pieces (≤5 tokens); a later revision should avoid applying it indiscriminately across small latency bins.
